title: InFlightChart
description: charts/inflight.json, written by servtuner analyze for the Queueing tab: L(t), the client's requests in flight, sampled each second over the stages from the request records (each request from sent_at for its E2E), and bucketed to at most 2000 points that keep each bucket's minimum and maximum; plus Little's law per stage. Warmup requests are left out.

start.description: The first stage's start; every offset is from here.

bucket_seconds.description: Seconds per point: 1, widened to keep at most 2000 points.

littleCheck.description: Little's law L = λ × W for one stage: the mean in flight against arrival rate × mean E2E. A large error means the stage was not in steady state.

little_error.description: |mean in flight − λ × mean E2E| ÷ (λ × mean E2E).
